scope: synthetic fixtures only; no real tracking accuracy
timing_scope: perf_counter tracker.update only; 5 unmeasured + 30 measured replays per scenario

metrics.matching: global identity assignment counts all IoU-qualified pairs; local frame assignment maximizes match count then IoU
metrics.fragmentation_definition: matched -> unmatched while GT present -> matched; absent GT alone is not an FN/fragment
metrics.switch_definition: new prediction ID versus last matched ID for the same annotated GT, including across gaps
metrics.limitations: No MOT ignore regions/classes/visibility preprocessing; target ID recovery is not person recognition or permission to resume follow.
